stepSecondsDefinition: Wall seconds of each step group: referencePreparation builds the reference from the prepared H5AD; referenceRegistration (CyteArc) marks the finished analysis as a mapping reference; referencePersistence and preparedReferenceLoad (comparators) save and load the trained reference; queryAnnotation reads the query and transfers labels
persistedReferenceDefinition: CyteArc: bytes written while registering the mapping reference from existing analysis artifacts; CellTypist: saved model files; Seurat and Symphony: uncompressed RDS plus Seurat's saved neighbor index
outcomeRule: Comparator records: a log naming the 2^31 - 1 limit is the dgCMatrix nonzero limit; outOfMemory, or a kill at 85% or more of the container memory, is out of memory; timedOut is the workflow time limit. CyteArc envelopes: failed with MemoryError is out of memory; a record still running after its job ended is incomplete
confusionDefinition: Rows are author labels and columns transferred labels, in confusionLabels order; one matrix per query donor, named study::donor
